blocks.orig: Aluna Paje is a hotel located in the heart of the lively centre of Paje, on the east coast of Zanzibar. Spread over several two-story buildings surrounding a swimming pool, it offers lovely rooms in nautical tones. Combining used dhow wood, and recycled materials such as milk cartons and African fabrics, Aluna creates a warm atmosphere in white and wood with colourful details. Huge palm trees give shade around the pool, where sunbeds and cocktails await, while chefs prepare freshly cooked meals in the restaurant. Last but not least, a rooftop terrace offers a wide view of the ocean and the village, and it’s the best place to witness a lovely sunset every evening.
blocks.html: In the heart of Paje's lively centre, on Zanzibar's east coast, you find the hotel Aluna Paje. Its pleasant rooms in nautical shades are spread across several two-storey buildings set around a swimming pool. Using old dhow wood and recycled materials like milk cartons and African fabrics, Aluna has created a warm look in white and wood with colourful touches. Tall palm trees shade the pool, where sunbeds and cocktails are waiting, and in the restaurant the chefs cook fresh meals. Finally, from the rooftop terrace you have a broad view over the ocean and the village, and it’s the best spot to watch a beautiful sunset every evening.
